scope: Segment/seam evidence repairs, local classification-band handling, protruding fitting geometry, registered exact-point picking, E57 validity fields and honest result diagnostics.

browser_workflow.platform: Linux Chromium; native Windows WebView2 not executed

steps.summary: One connected lining component was found. Connectivity has not separated the lining into physical segments; use Segments from seams to inspect measured joint boundaries.

steps.status: 3 segment candidates in 1 of 1 observed ring intervals. Review the measured seams; missing seams can still merge physical panels.

lining_segmentation.validation_kind: controlled regressions and supplied real E57 execution; no human-labelled segment ground truth

detection.summary: 60 segment candidates in 15 of 19 observed ring intervals. Other intervals or conflicting boundaries remain unassigned. Review the measured seams; missing seams can still merge physical panels.
151 segment candidates in 23 of 25 observed ring intervals. Other intervals or conflicting boundaries remain unassigned. Review the measured seams; missing seams can still merge physical panels.

limitations: Counts are candidate detections, not validated physical segment counts.
Observed gaps can contain missing ring seams, so candidate regions can merge physical panels.
The reviewed input is a roughly139m registered E57 with5,921,285 points, not a350M or billion-point field benchmark.
Elapsed times include concurrent validation activity and are not controlled performance comparisons.
No intensity brightness inversion, missing-return seam invention, assumed segment count, design snapping or source-coordinate changes were introduced.

real_classification.model_fit_source: same full registered scan and unchanged GuSAC default settings
real_classification.combined_phase_timing_note: Sum of the recorded original full-scan GuSAC preparation and final classification run reusing that unchanged model; not a fresh single-run wall-clock measurement.

statistics.strategy: full-density exact radius components with disk-backed global connectivity; GuSAC cleaning decisions retained separately

classification.summary: 6,000 connected lining components were found; 0 observed ring bands have sufficient support. Components require review before treating them as physical segments.
classification.ring_status: Ring labels withheld: fewer than two independently supported, separated longitudinal bands remain. Review the unresolved groups.

warnings: The 6,000-group review metadata budget was reached. 7,003 additional qualifying components (293,059 original points) are retained as unclassified label 0. Every original point was processed; use a smaller review area or increase the component minimum to name those fragments separately.
2,304,910 lining points remain unclassified: point spacing, incomplete joints or the component minimum do not support reliable clustering at this connection distance. These points are retained.
TMatch is an independent interpretation: connection distance R joins actual lining points; minimum N applies to the final component. The paper supplies no universal R/N values.
Joints narrower than the 15 mm connection distance can join neighbouring blocks. Review the coloured clusters; increase radius only when point spacing requires it.
Every selected original point is labelled. Small/unresolved lining groups, recesses and uncertain GuSAC decisions remain retained; only interior obstruction candidates start excluded.
Ring labels withheld: fewer than two independently supported, separated longitudinal bands remain. Review the unresolved groups.
Colours identify geometric instances, not semantic cable/pipe types. Segment types and theoretical sector boundaries require the correct project design.

count_definitions.lining_points: All original points assigned GuSAC class 0 supported lining, including named and unclassified connectivity groups.
count_definitions.unclassified_points: Supported-lining points left at label 0: undersized/unresolved connectivity components plus qualifying components deferred by the named-group metadata budget.
count_definitions.underresolved_points: Supported-lining points in components below the final 30-point minimum; no individually named component.
count_definitions.metadata_deferred_points: Supported-lining points in qualifying components beyond the 6,000 named-group review budget; retained under label 0.
count_definitions.classification.unresolved_lining_points: Sum of unclassified supported-lining points (2,597,969) and GuSAC class 3 insufficient-evidence points (433,597). The latter are uncertain geometry, not verified lining. This combined count excludes separately retained class 2 recesses and class 4 normal disagreements.
count_definitions.supported_component_points: Original supported-lining points in the 6,000 individually named connected components; this does not establish physical segment identity.
count_definitions.rings: Supported observed ring bands. Zero in this real-scan default-settings execution.

real_classification.actual_scan_outcome: Default 15 mm connectivity completed but fragmented the actual scan; no supported ring bands. It is not a successful physical segment classification or an accuracy validation.
